title: SvgSymbol
responsibility: Renders the native symbol element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgSymbol.attributes
inputs.description: Native symbol attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgSymbol.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native symbol element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgSymbol
outputs.description: The actual native symbol element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
